provenance.note: village-water-profile-v2: 48 Gram Panchayats in THIRUVIDAIMARUDUR block assessed against 40 capabilities by the evidence rules in src/lib/atlas/capability-evidence.ts (capability-evidence-v2). Each requirement records its state (adequate, unavailable, not-applicable, not-assessed), the evidence with its locality class and projection method, and limitations. A capability with no rule is reported unavailable rather than guessed; an undetermined applicability is not-assessed rather than a gap.
